O. Knill (2017); M. A. Villarino and J. C. Varilly (2024) -- the trihyperboloid and its volume ln 256.
C. Dupin, "Applications de Geometrie et de Mechanique", Paris 1822;
B. Odehnal, "Ortho-Circles of Dupin Cyclides", J. Geometry Graphics 10 (2006) 1-21 -- the inversion construction and the ring / horn / spindle classification.

J. Tannery, Bulletin des sciences mathematiques, 2e serie, 16 (1892) 190; O. Zoll, "Ueber Flaechen mit Scharen geschlossener geodaetischer Linien", Math. Ann. 57 (1903) 108-133; A. L. Besse, "Manifolds all of whose Geodesics are Closed", Springer 1978.
